release: H.10 Foreign Exchange Rates, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
note: Noon buying rates in New York for cable transfers payable in foreign currencies, as the history pages print them. Each year is one string: one entry per calendar day from January 1, separated by commas; an empty entry is a day with no rate (a weekend, a holiday, ND). quote: units_per_dollar is units of the currency for one U.S. dollar; dollars_per_unit (the release's asterisk) is U.S. dollars for one unit.
